name: Mohawk Commons
summary: Mohawk Commons is a community shopping center on Balltown Road in Schenectady, offering a convenient mix of national retailers, dining, and services. The open-air center serves as a practical shopping destination for local families and professionals throughout the greater Schenectady area.
demographics: Mohawk Commons serves the greater Schenectady area, attracting middle-income families and working professionals from the surrounding suburban neighborhoods. The trade area draws from households with moderate to above-average incomes, with a mix of young families, established homeowners, and retirees seeking convenient shopping options. Primary shoppers are value-conscious consumers who appreciate the convenience of having grocery, dining, and essential retail services in one location. The center benefits from its position along Balltown Road, a major commercial corridor that serves both local residents and commuters.
description: Mohawk Commons is a well-established community shopping center located at 402 Balltown Road in Schenectady, New York. Strategically positioned along one of the area's primary commercial corridors, this open-air center serves as a convenient shopping destination for residents throughout the greater Schenectady region. The center features a practical mix of national retailers, dining options, and service-oriented businesses that cater to everyday shopping needs. With its accessible location and ample parking, Mohawk Commons has become a reliable choice for local families and professionals seeking quality shopping experiences close to home. The center maintains strong community ties and continues to evolve its tenant mix to meet the changing needs of Schenectady-area shoppers, operating daily from 9:00 AM to 9:00 PM for maximum convenience.
